what: The photo is split into 3×3 cells. When the top edge of the panel reaches 80% of the screen, each cell grows by clip-path from its top-left corner point to full cell size. Five diagonal groups ([0] [1,3] [2,4,6] [5,7] [8]) start .125s apart, cells inside a group start .1s apart, and each runs .5s power2.out. Scrolling back up folds them in reverse

options.each: Gap between cells in group (sec), default .1
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”, default power2.out
options.once: If ‹true›, it opens once and never reverts (default: folds back when scrolled back up past it)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo to open (child) — one copy per cell, stacked. If none, the first child

note: Cell boundaries overlap by half a cell at 33/33.5% like the original, so no seam shows when all are open

from.where: media.js .yf-reveal (DJ page photo cells) — original Revealmedia: 9 cells clip-path point → cell, groups [[0],[1,3],[2,4,6],[5,7],[8]] × .125s, .5s power2.out stagger .1, start top 80%, toggleActions play none none reverse
